oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 1890012345 - inference-prod p99 latency spike detected across eu-west-1. Paging primary and secondary oncall. See runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/inference/p99-latency
Ana: I'm primary for tonight but stuck in airport, wifi is flaky. I can stay on call for 30m but won't be able to handle a pager if it needs deep debugging. :airplane:
Mike: I can take primary if Ana hands off now, I'm remote and available. Can someone confirm the incident severity before we flip?
oncall-bot: Current incidents: latency spike impacting ~5% of requests, automatic fallback to smaller model happening, customers affected: 2 high-volume tenants. Severity: P1 if impact persists >15m.
Leo: Quick check — is KV cache warm? I see elevated queue times on the serving runtime dashboard. https://console.redwood/metrics/serving?span=15m
Surya: On the traffic side, looks like an unusual batch size distribution spike; autoscaler didn't scale up because most requests are short. Could be batching regression from recent optimizer patch.
Jess: If we're swapping primary, follow the handoff checklist in the oncall-runbook: `1) Ack incident, 2) Handover in thread, 3) Update pager duty, 4) Confirm access`
Ana: Mike, handing off primary to you. I will update PagerDuty and pin the thread. I'm putting runbook steps I started below.
Ana: Runbook snippet I executed: ```
# quick actions
curl -s https://ops.redwood/internal/health | jq .latency
# force fallback off for canary
opsctl routing set-fallback --model small --off
```
Mike: Got it. I'm primary now. Done: acknowledged, set myself as primary in PagerDuty, added a customer-facing note to the incident doc. I'll run the quick checks and coordinate mitigation.
Mike: Leo / Surya — can you triage kernel/quantization rollback possibility? If the recent optimizer patch is suspect we should rollback to previous runtime build in eu-west-1 canary.
Leo: I'll validate the kernel selection logs. If we see mismatched kernels after the optimizer, we can roll back the runtime config. I need a minute to pull logs.
Surya: Meanwhile I'll adjust batching thresholds to reduce queueing: `batchctl update --region eu-west-1 --target 16` and observe. This will slightly increase cost but reduce p99.
Jess: Heads-up — product wants a short customer update. If we hold <30m, say "mitigation in progress, minimal customer impact for most users". If >30m, escalate to engineering leaders.
oncall-bot: Reminder: when handing off primary, include `--access-list` confirmation. Mike, please confirm you can access the private metrics workspace and can perform canary rollback.
Mike: Confirmed — I have access and ability to trigger canary rollback. Initiating controlled rollback to runtime v2.7 in eu-west-1 canary now. Command: `infractl deploy --region eu-west-1 --service inference-runtime --version v2.7 --canary 10%`
Ana: Thanks team. I'm going to step out to board but will monitor thread; if things go red please @Ana explicitly. Good handoff checklist completed. :thumbsup:
Leo: Logs look noisy but aligned with the optimizer patch timing. There are kernel mismatches in ~2 hosts. Rolling out rollback should help.
Surya: Batching update applied, p99 dropping from 730ms -> 420ms so far. Keep watching for regressions.
Mike: Canary rollback in progress — 10% healthy so far. If metrics improve in 5m, we'll promote. Updating incident doc and pinging support for customer comms.
oncall-bot: Automated monitor: p99 latency decreased to 410ms (5m window). No new pager events.
Jess: Thanks Mike/Ana/Surya/Leo. If the canary fully stabilizes, plan is to promote and then run a post-incident triage tomorrow. I'll spin up the postmortem doc.
Mike: Canary promoted to 50% then 100%. Metrics stable. Closing the immediate mitigation. I'll keep monitoring for 1h and then perform a final handback to Ana if she's reachable.
Ana: I can take back primary after I land and get a stable connection in ~45m. If anything else fires, call me.
Mike: Understood. Reassigning primary back to Ana at 1890014800. For now, this thread closed for active mitigation. Document notes: rollback of optimizer patch in eu-west-1, temporary batching threshold increase, customer updates sent.
oncall-bot: Incident 1890012345 status changed: mitigated -> monitoring. Please file a postmortem within 48 hours.
